Note that animations are ordered in clockwise order starting from right, so idle0 should face right, idle1 faces bottom-right, idle2 faces bottom, etc.; the same applies to run0 through run7. Use the crusader_idle spritesheet for the idle animation, but crusader_walk for the run animations. Name the nodes the same as each node's class names (AnimatedSprite2D and CollisionShape2D, case sensitive).
